content: For a tiny (41-doc) offline corpus, lexical BM25 is sufficient and avoids any embedding model. rank-bm25 0.2.2 is pure-Python+numpy (99MB disk incl numpy, 8.7M downloads/month) but is unmaintained since 2022 and has a known numpy-2 alias risk (np.float_ removed). bm25s 0.3.13 is maintained and ~100x faster but pulls scipy (479MB). Pure-Python snowballstemmer 3.1.1 (zero deps) provides deterministic English stemming. A ~40-line in-house BM25/TF-IDF over a 41-doc corpus is dependency-free and deterministic.
